items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: I heard some records of, uh, well, first I heard, uh, some, uh, fellow tell me, says, you know, there's a Negro fellow on the south side of the name of King Joe Oliver.

ctx.x: I'm a kid. I'm a kid. Now, when did you take up the, uh, cornet?

Oh, I took up the cornet, uh, I heard some records of, uh, well, first I heard, uh, some, uh, fellow tell me, says, you know, there's a Negro fellow on the south side of the name of King Joe Oliver. Says, you ought to try and get down and see if you can't listen to him. Cause I was just fooling around with the cornet, just seeing I couldn't read or anything, just, I didn't know the fingering, I was just fooling around while I was playing drums in school. So, one night, this fellow called on me and says, well, why…
Yeah, I remember the place was the fire station in the days I knew it. That's it. That's it. Had been a theater and everything, I think, there at one time, in the nightclub up above, was it?
